(a) `computeTextLayout(text,font,size,fixedWidthWorld)` (8388-8428) is a PURE function — no read of `state`/`project`/DOM beyond a scratch `document.createElement('canvas')` (8398), no write of any external variable. `SS=3` (8396, comment 8389-8395 explains the 2->3 bump, 2026-07: the only crispness lever available without vector glyph rendering in the Rust/vello engine). Canvas sizing: `off.width=Math.ceil(wMax)+16;off.height=Math.ceil(wrapped.length*lineH)+16` (8419) — 16px total padding (8px each side) baked directly into the offscreen canvas dimensions, matching `lineDrawX`'s own 8px left/right insets (8433-8434). Wrap algorithm: only runs when `fixedWidthWorld` is truthy (8403); greedy word-wrap by splitting each input line on `' '` (8407), accumulating words into `cur` while `octx.measureText(test).width<=fixedWidthPx-16` (8409), else pushing `cur` and starting a new line with the overflowing word (8409-8410) — a SINGLE word wider than the box is never itself split; it is pushed alone as its own line once `cur` is empty (the `cur?cur+' '+w:w` ternary at 8408 means the first word of a fresh line is never rejected by the width check, since `cur` is falsy and the `if` condition requires `cur&&...`). Return shape: `{off:off,octx:octx,wrapped:wrapped,lineH:lineH,SS:SS}` (8428) — `off`/`octx` are the SAME offscreen canvas/context object handed back to the caller for the actual `fillText` pass (the layout pass measures with `octx` before the canvas is resized to its final dimensions at 8419-8422, then re-fetches `octx` afterward at 8425-8426 since 'resizing the canvas resets its context/state', comment 8425).

(a continued) `lineDrawX(off,octx,line,align)` (8429-8434) is likewise pure: given the ALREADY-sized `off`/`octx`, returns the left-edge x for one line of text per `align` — `(off.width-tw)/2` for center (8431), `off.width-8-tw` for right (8432), `8` for left/default (8433) — `tw` is `octx.measureText(line).width` (8430).

(b) The raster bake pipeline, in order, for BOTH `commitText` branches (8501-8555): read the five popover fields — `txt` (8502), `size` (8504, `parseInt(...)||48`), `font` (8505, `||'sans-serif'`), `align` (8506, `||'left'`), `color` (8507-8508, `colorInp.value||state.strokeColor||'#000000'`) — then `fixedWidthWorld=_textPendingBox?_textPendingBox.width:null` (8509); the `vector:` dispatch to `commitVectorText` and early `return` (8510-8513); `L=computeTextLayout(...)` (8514) then the actual `fillText` bake — `wrapped.forEach` calling `octx.fillText(l,lineDrawX(off,octx,l,align),8+i*lineH)` per line (8516-8519, note the SAME `8` top padding `lineDrawX`'s own left/right 8px insets mirror vertically); `off.toDataURL('image/png')` (8520); `pushUndo()` (8521); `textMeta={text,font,size,color,align,fixedWidth}` built once (8522) and written identically onto whichever Raster is chosen below. Branch A — re-edit, `_textEditingRaster&&_textEditingRaster.parent` truthy (8523): writes `r.data.isText=true;r.data.src=url` plus all five `textMeta` fields onto the SAME `r` (8526-8527), keeps `r.bounds.topLeft` as the anchor (8525, comment: 'doesn't re-center on the old click point'), then `r.source=url` (8529) — reassigning `.source` keeps the same item identity (index/parent/references), the SAME edit-in-place pattern any other Raster in this codebase uses; `r.onLoad` (8528) resizes/repositions then calls `saveActiveLayerFrame();updateUI()` and a guarded `renderNow()`. Branch B — new item, `_textEditingRaster` falsy (8530-8553): the `isTextLayer` auto-tag fires ONLY when the active layer is currently empty and not already tagged (8540, `layer.children.length===0&&!ldForTag.isTextLayer`) — never overriding a layer the user already filled with other content; `project.activeLayer` is swapped to the target layer (`prev=project.activeLayer;layer.activate()`, 8541) so `new Raster(url)` (8542) lands in the RIGHT layer regardless of which layer Paper.js currently has active, then swapped back (`prev.activate()`, 8552) immediately after construction — the swap brackets only the `new Raster` call, not the async `onLoad`. The `isBox` centre-vs-point rule (8546, 8549): `pt=_textPendingBox?_textPendingBox.topLeft.clone():_textPendingPt` (8545) — for a fixed-width box, `r2.position` becomes `pt.add(half-size)` (centring the baked bitmap inside the box's own top-left-anchored footprint, 8549); for point text, `r2.position=pt` directly (no centring — matches raster point-text's OWN convention, distinct from `commitVectorText`'s point-click placement which anchors top-left, 8445-8449). Both branches converge on `closeTextPopover()` as the LAST statement of `commitText` (8554) — confirmed the only `closeTextPopover` call in `commitText`'s own body.

(c) `commitVectorText`'s edit path (8441, 8463-8472) vs create path (8444/8449, then straight to 8474-8475): edit fires when `_textEditingRaster` exists, has a `.parent`, and carries `.data.isTextRoot` (8441, `editingRoot`) — topLeft is then the UNION of every existing member's bounds via `vectorTextGroupMembers(editingRoot).reduce(...)` (8443), every member's `charIndex`->`strokeId` list is harvested into `_oldIdByChar` BEFORE removal (8466-8470, a LIST per index since 'a character can be several paths — a counter, an accent', comment 8464-8465), then every member is removed (`.forEach(function(p){p.remove();})`, 8471) — remove-all-then-rebuild, confirmed. Create path skips all of that: topLeft comes from `_textPendingBox.topLeft` (8444) or, failing that, `_textPendingPt` itself, anchored TOP-LEFT unlike raster point-text's own centring (8445-8449, comment explicits the divergence from Branch B above). `charIndex` handling on rebuild (8476-8492, inside `buildVectorTextGroup`'s own `.then()`): for each NEW character carrying a `charIndex`, the corresponding OLD `strokeId` queue for that index is popped FIFO (`queues[ci].shift()`, implicit via `q.shift()` at 8483) and reassigned onto the new path (`p.data.strokeId=oid`, 8484) — reused ids are tracked (`reused[oid]=1`) so any OLD id left over (a character that disappeared) has its `elementMotion`/`shapeNames` entries explicitly deleted (8489-8490) rather than left as dead weight, matching the 2026-07 comment's own stated motivation (8454-8461: a rename previously left 9 orphaned animation entries). Divergence from `closeInPlaceTextEditor`'s own rebuild (C19y, cited by name/line only, not reproduced here — its own function name per C19y's own scope description is `closeInPlaceTextEditor`, distinct from the RASTER editor's `closeInPlaceRasterTextEditor` this scope's `commitText` is called from at 8376): no duplicated logic was found — `closeInPlaceTextEditor`'s scope is out of this artifact's own read boundary (7995-8382) and is cited by name only per the issue's own instruction; a full comparison of its rebuild path against this scope's `commitVectorText` is therefore not performed here (would require reading C19y's own body, out of scope for this leaf).

(e) The split's exact output contract (`splitTextIntoCharacters`, 8591-8661): one Raster per NON-WHITESPACE character — whitespace is explicitly skipped from producing a Raster (`if(ch.trim()===''){cursor+=chW;atWordStart=true;return;}`, 8632, still advances the draw cursor and word-boundary tracking, just never calls `new Raster`) and excluded from the `totalChars` count that gates the shared completion callback (8601-8602, `if(ch.trim()!=='')totalChars++`).
